title: TwinVision Copper Pit - live vs baseline
description: Live twin (what-if scenarios applied) against the baseline twin (same seed, no scenarios). Data: twinvision-sim -> MQTT -> Ditto -> Telegraf -> InfluxDB.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "value_tph_mined_properties_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId == "org.twinvision.copper:mine" or r.thingId == "org.twinvision.copper:mine-baseline")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), series: if r.thingId == "org.twinvision.copper:mine" then "live" else "baseline"}))
  |> group(columns: ["series"])
